text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After the Winning Live, Smart Falcon 
reunited with the fan she had made a 
promise to.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Hey, hey, how was the Winning Live?

text_block_list.name: Female Fan A
text_block_list.text:
I-It was so amazing, just the absolute 
best! T-Thank you so very, very much!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Aha☆ Thanks to you too for cheering me on♪ 
So, the person next to you is...?

text_block_list.name: Female Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes, that's right! My best friend who 
was feeling so down! But it looks like 
she's completely cheered up now...!

text_block_list.name: Female Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Fwawawa, it's the real Falco-chan! Um, 
your performance... w-w-was magnificent!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, thanks☆ If you ever feel down 
again, come to my concert, okay?

text_block_list.name: Female Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Hai-ee! I'd go as many times as you'd take 
me! A-And... please let me thank you for 
today!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Smart Falcon was guided by her fan 
into a ramen shop.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Waaah! So you were a ramen shop owner all 
along!

text_block_list.name: Female Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Watching your live show inspired a whole 
new ramen recipe, Falco-chan. Please, try 
some!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Huh, ramen at my concert!? What's that 
supposed to mean~??

text_block_list.name: Female Fan A
text_block_list.text:
"She was troubled about her new ramen 
recipe for so long... And now that it's 
sorted out... sniff, I'm sho happy for 
herrr!"

text_block_list.name: Female Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Here's the new creation! 'Umadol☆Ramen', 
coming right up! This is my answer!!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, that looks so delicious! Bon 
appétit~~♪

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
(The rich umami of crab condensed within 
the hearty miso, and beneath the butter, a 
subtle touch of milk enhances the 
flavor... In other words!)

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
It has such a gentle flavor☆ It's so yummy 
I might end up eating way too much~~♪

text_block_list.name: Female Fan B
text_block_list.text:
I imagined all the ingredients shining 
brightly, each aiming for center stage and 
elevating one another...!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Incredible! It really is Umadol☆Ramen, 
isn't it♪ Falco loves this so much~~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Smart Falcon enjoyed the delicious ramen 
while mingling with her fans.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Smart Falcon was guided by her fan 
to a high point overlooking the city.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Wah, what a beautiful view...! It's such a 
lovely place♪

text_block_list.name: Female Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, it's my proud scenic spot! I 
thought if I was going to show you, this 
would be the place...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
What the fan unfurled was a large handmade 
banner.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"Go get 'em, Falco-chan!" ...it says! Oh 
gosh, I'm so happy!

text_block_list.name: Female Fan B
text_block_list.text:
It's made using the same dyeing technique 
as the local specialties! I've always 
wanted a job making theseâ

text_block_list.name: Female Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to you, Falco-chan, they found the 
courage to take that first step... I'm sho 
happyyy~!!

text_block_list.name: Female Fan B
text_block_list.text:
I really wanted to make it in time for the 
concert, but... I'm sorry for being late.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
No, we're still in time...! After all, the 
concert is just about to start♪

text_block_list.name: Female Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh!? Even though you're tired, you'd do 
that!? Plus, we don't even have any 
equipment here...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"It'll be fine♪ When an Umadol sings and 
dances, wherever she stands becomes her 
stage☆"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Surrounded by warm fans, Smart Falcon 
stood on stage for the second time that 
day.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Smart Falcon was guided by her fan 
to the front of the station.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Wah-wah, what a crowd! Does it always get 
this packed after a race?

text_block_list.name: Female Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Yes... It's especially lively today... so 
I thought maybe I'd do a-a street 
performance!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Ehhh?! Don't tell me you're... too?!

text_block_list.name: Female Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Yes, she's aiming to become an idol too! 
She said Falco-chan gave her so much 
energy that she was able to, to start 
running toward her dream...!!

text_block_list.name: Female Fan B
text_block_list.text:
U-Um... could you give me some advice 
before my debut stage?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Well, you see, your very first stage is a 
treasure that stays in your heart forever 
and ever.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
So... um... ehehe. Trying to act cool is 
tough, huh? ☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, there's only one thing I can say! Go 
have tons of fun♪

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I'll be watching your concert from the 
front row☆

text_block_list.name: Female Fan B
text_block_list.text:
F-Falco-chan... thank you...! I really, 
truly love you so much~~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, Smart Falcon cheered louder 
than anyone else during the concert.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Smart Falcon was guided by her fan 
to a nearby underpass.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Wah, it's so relaxing here~♪ ...Huh, where 
did those two go?

text_block_list.name: Female Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Hello, hello~! We're the Hankyo Sisters! 
If nothing else, at least remember our 
names before you go~

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: "...Wah-wah-wah! What is it~?"

text_block_list.name: Female Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Well, I just love cute Umadols, y'see. 
Watchin' the rates fluctuate on TV gets my 
heart pumpin' like crazy~.

text_block_list.name: Female Fan A
text_block_list.text:
That's 'forex yen-dollar,' not a 'cute 
Umadol'!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha☆ That's hilarious! Wait, were you 
two comedians or something?

text_block_list.name: Female Fan B
text_block_list.text:
We used to do comedy skits together at 
school festivals and things like that! 
...I had given up on it, to be honest, 
but—

text_block_list.name: Female Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Drawing courage from you, Falco-chan, we 
were able to get our duo back together! 
We're aiming to go pro!

text_block_list.name: Female Fan A
text_block_list.text:
S-S-So that's why! Please teach me the 
proper mindset for taking the stage, 
Master!!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
*ahem*... Well then, I'll share what I've 
learned about the stage so far☆

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, Smart Falcon imparted the two 
of them with the "Mindset on Stage"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And Smart Falcon arrived at the cafe, 
guided by one of her fans.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Such a super stylish shop~. If I lived 
nearby, I'd come here all the time☆

text_block_list.name: Female Fan A
text_block_list.text:
I-It's her shop! It seems sales were so 
bad she was thinking of closing it down, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Female Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to you, Falco-chan, I felt like 
trying my hardest once more!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Really!? That's great♪ It's such a lovely 
shop, I want it to stay open☆

text_block_list.name: Female Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe... Here are some sweets as a 
thank-you! They're donuts made in 
Falco-chan's image!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! It looks just like Falco's face! And 
the ribbon decoration is super cute~~♪

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Let's show everyone on Umatter☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Wah-wah, incredible~♪ Everyone is saying 
they want this donut!

text_block_list.name: Female Fan B
text_block_list.text:
R-Really!? I'd love for everyone to eat 
some too...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
If we turn this into merch, it'll 
definitely be a massive hit! We'll call it 
"Falco Donuts," and it's my officially 
endorsed sweet♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, the "Falco Donuts" became a hit 
item, and business at the shop boomed!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Smart Falcon was guided by her fan 
to the riverbank.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Faaan fa fa faaaan♪ Fa fa faaaan♪)

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Waaah! It's a fanfare! It totally puts you 
in the pre-race mood♪

text_block_list.name: Female Fan B
text_block_list.text:
E-Ehehe... I've been taking trumpet 
lessons ever since I was little...

text_block_list.name: Female Fan A
text_block_list.text:
She's trying to join an orchestra! But she 
hasn't been able to pass the auditions...

text_block_list.name: Female Fan B
text_block_list.text:
I thought about giving up... But watching 
Falco-chan's race gave me the resolve to 
keep trying!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Yaaay! Falco is so happy☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"Because when I heard your sound, I just 
felt this surge of 'Let's do this!'♪"

text_block_list.name: Female Fan B
text_block_list.text: Huh? R-Really!?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Yep♪ If you join an orchestra, I'd love 
for you to play at Falco's live concerts 
too♪ Let's meet on stage one day! It's a 
promise☆

text_block_list.name: Female Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes, sir! I will definitely join the 
troupe!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Sharing a passionate handshake, Smart 
Falcon and the others promised each other 
a future stage together!
